description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Header' that renders a navigation bar with session-aware actions, including links for signing in, signing up, and signing out, as well as role-specific links for 'HR' and 'Admin'. It also displays user information when authenticated.

methods.name: Header()
methods.description: React functional component that renders the header/navigation bar with session and role management.

methods.name: onSignOut
methods.description: Handles user sign-out action, calls signOut(), and shows notification based on success or failure.
